newsitem.title: USA: SNET issues $100 mln medium term notes.
newsitem.headline: SNET issues $100 mln medium term notes.

text.p: Southern New England Telecommunications Corp said on Tuesday that it issued $100 million of 6.50 percent medium term notes due February 15, 2002.
The notes were priced at 99.769 percent of par to yield 6.54 percent, Southern New England Telecommunications said.
The notes were underwritten by Lehman Brothers and Salomon Brothers, the company said.
Proceeds will be used to refinance commercial paper issued when it bought cellular properties in July 1995, Southern New England Telecommunications said.
